label: Voice Outcomes of Patients Intubated for Critical COVID Illness: A Multicenter Study.
summary: Characterize the long-term vocal outcomes of patients who required ICU care for COVID-19 infection. Prospective cohort study. Multi-institutional North American Airway Collaborative Study.
